comparison.objective: Fill a bath by opening cold before hot and turning hot off first; the candidate performs gripper stop calibration.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate two tap levers in a safety-critical order, not precision two-tool countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Cold-first/hot-off-first sequencing and fill level determine score; any hot-only interval irreversibly fails.
comparison.reason: Order-of-controls safety is unrelated to the candidate's mechanical locking outcome.
